why:

E3 (#12684, merged 3afc02b) wired the shared fee+slippage+funding cost model into the harnesses that lacked it; this PR is the re-run E3's own note said was 'explicitly not started there'.

SCOPE ACTUALLY COVERED, stated precisely because R1's original note scoped 'all 55 legs' and this PR does not cover that population -- see docs/CLAUDE-RULES-CANONICAL.md RULE ONE on stating the population. `scripts/ci/check_roster_promotion_evidence.py --population` is the narrower, decision-relevant population: the 12 legs on a risk-bearing (real_money/prop) roster today. 11 of those 12 were re-measured this session through their existing harness (backtest_trend.py / backtest_pullback.py), whose own CLI path already resolves slippage+funding to venue-aware defaults -- so for this leg family the harness math was already correct pre-E3; the gap R1 closes here is that `comms/strategy_evidence/<leg>.json` (the evidence record the promotion-evidence guard actually reads) carried no `cost_stack` or `decision_rule` block. `scripts/ops/build_strategy_evidence.py` is extended to read the harness's own resolved fee/slippage/funding bps into a `cost_stack` block and to grade each run against a `decision_rule` registered (2026-09-22T05:34:08Z) strictly before any run this session performed.

MEASURED RESULT: `check_roster_promotion_evidence.py --population` goes from 0/12 clearing the operator's four-clause bar to 8/12 (on this branch; 0/12 remains true of main until this merges). 3 of the 11 re-run legs (eth_pullback_prop_2h, trend_donchian@bybit_2, eth_pullback_2h) FLIP from fee-only-positive to net-negative once slippage+funding are priced -- the EXPECTED SHAPE R1's note predicted, though only 3/11 flipped here, not a majority; the 45/55-leg 'majority fails' prediction remains UNTESTED because only these 11 legs ran.

NOT DONE, and filed rather than silently dropped (docs/claude/work/PIPELINE.jsonl row PI-20260922-R1-REMAINING-CORPUS): (1) `fvg_range_15m`, the 12th risk-bearing leg, is still `no_harness` -- `regime_debt_matrix.classify()` has no branch for the fvg_range family, a pre-existing classifier gap unrelated to cost defaults. (2) The remaining ~43 legs of the full live roster outside the risk-bearing population were not re-run. (3) The three harnesses E3 filed as having no bps cost model at all (backtest_orb.py, src/backtest/backtester.py, xsec_momentum's funding term) are untouched by this producer.

NOT DONE, on purpose, per this session's standing instruction: no automatic demotion was applied. `MD-DEMOTE-S1-OFF`, named in R1's original note, is not a registered mandate (config/mandates.yaml has no such entry) and this lane did not create one. `config/accounts.yaml` and `config/strategies.yaml` are untouched -- cutting the fleet is R2/D2 and is Tier-3.
